label: Quarry
description: An automation quarry program for mining turtles

config.name: fuelInventorySide
config.label: Fuel Inventory Side
config.description: The side of the turtle an inventory of fuel will be made available.

config.name: minimumFuelStock
config.label: Minimum Fuel Stock
config.description: The minimum fuel the turtle should take when restocking before continuing to operate.

config.name: refuelThresholdPercent
config.label: Refuel Threshold
config.description: The minimum fuel percent the turtle should operate at before attempting to refuel.

config.name: refuelAmountPercent
config.label: Refuel Amount
config.description: The fuel percent the turtle should reach when refueling before continuing to operate.

config.name: storeInventorySide
config.label: Store Inventory Side
config.description: The side of the turtle an inventory to store mined resources will be made available.

config.name: diggingToolSide
config.label: Digging Tool Side
config.description: The side of the turtle a tool is present that should be used to dig blocks.

config.name: x
config.label: Max X
config.description: The max X coordinate the quarry should cover.

config.name: z
config.label: Max Z
config.description: The max Z coordinate the quarry should cover.

config.name: y
config.label: Max Y
config.description: The max Y coordinate the quarry should cover.

config.name: ySkip
config.label: Y Skip
config.description: The number of blocks down to skip before quarrying.
